name: fastcrud-declarative-joined-aggregate-projections
instr:
Add declarative aggregate projections to joined reads so callers can compute related-record sums, averages, minima, maxima, counts, and distinct counts without leaving FastCRUD's discovery, pagination, nesting, or endpoint flows. Callers control each projection's public alias, filtering, distinctness, execution mode, and empty-set result.

Equivalent manual and metadata-discovered relationship targets produce identical aggregate values, including selective discovery. Correlated and grouped projections preserve one result per primary identity, even with one-to-many fields, aliased joins, multiple primary fields, and multiple aggregates. Aggregate filters and distinctness affect only their projection, while primary and ordinary join filters retain their existing scopes. Sorting, offset, limit, and total_count continue to describe primary records rather than expanded joined rows. Response conversion preserves every aggregate alias as a collision-free primary-level scalar in flat and nested output: dictionaries require no aggregate schema, while requested model conversion passes projected fields to aggregate-bearing schemas and leaves ordinary Pydantic validation failures visible. Invalid targets, columns, operations, aliases, or conflicting join inputs raise AggregateConfigurationError before SQL executes. Generated list endpoints preserve their pagination envelopes and HTTP error mapping, and calls without aggregates retain existing join, discovery, count-only, nesting, and pag
